queries: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.average_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS gap FROM per_patient AS pp CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.average_wbc, pa.ratio, pa.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS gap FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The patient ratio is the average of each laboratory record’s HGB/HCT; records with missing values or zero HCT contribute no ratio.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each patient’s ratio by dividing their average HGB by their average HCT, with missing values ignored in each average.
